text:
Type: wall sconce with shelf
Use: bedside reading light and small storage; bedroom, living room; mounted beside a bed
Style: modern, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: matte black metal arm, white fabric shade, light wood round tray
Colors: matte black, off-white, light natural wood
Shape: tall swooping J-shaped arm, tapered drum shade hanging from top, round wooden platform below, round backplate, plug-in cord, tall and slender
Feel: practical, calm, airy
Goes with: light wood, white walls, black accents; Scandinavian or modern bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Light Wood Platform Wall Sconce with USB Port - 12.5 x 9 x 25 Inches, Matte Black
product.description: This wall sconce can bring personality to any interior living space with its matte-black metal base, white fabric shade, and wood platform. Plug your smartphone into this sconce’s USB port and set it on the platform for a quick and easy charge. 12.5''W x 9''D x 25''H Wood; matte-black metal; white fabric shade USB port for your phone Type A, Bulb not included Professional installation recommended For indoor use only
